candidates.source_name: MNB Aranykönyv (Golden Book) – interaktív, felügyelt intézmények egyedi adatai
candidates.why_relevant: Per-institution audited balance sheet and P&L data for every supervised Hungarian institution (credit institutions, financial enterprises, e-money and payment institutions, investment firms, fund managers, insurers, funds), in comparable form and as a time series (2003 onwards). This is the single best cross-bank comparable financial dataset in Hungary and the anchor source of this cell.
candidates.legal_status: official public statistics; MNB terms of use apply, attribution expected
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled annual/quarterly fetch of the XLSX downloads plus inspection of the interactive app's underlying JSON/API calls; parse into per-institution time series keyed by institution name + MNB registration id.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query hu + fetch of supervisory statistics index

candidates.source_name: MNB Ajánlások (supervisory recommendations index) – incl. disclosure recommendations
candidates.why_relevant: The index of MNB recommendations defines WHAT institutions must disclose and WHEN. Recommendation 7/2022 (IV.22.) on general disclosure requirements replaced 9/2021 (VI.23.) from 1 June 2022 and governs Pillar 3 practice under Hpt. (Act CCXXXVII of 2013) and CRR 575/2013/EU. Essential for knowing the shape, timing and comparability of every Hungarian bank's Pillar 3 report.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the index, download each PDF, track supersessions (recommendation number + effective date) as a rules registry.

negative_findings.description: No public bulk-download or documented API endpoint was found for the MNB Intézménykereső register (intezmenykereso.mnb.hu). Searches in Hungarian for a downloadable list ('lista letöltés', 'nyilvántartás') returned only licensing-guidance PDFs and the search UI itself.
negative_findings.result_summary: Register appears to be a query-only web application; bulk extraction likely requires enumerating its internal XHR endpoints or headless browsing.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The register is the master actor list for the whole HU run; if it cannot be bulk-extracted, every downstream cell needs a more expensive enumeration strategy or a fallback list source.

negative_findings.description: No MNB-hosted central repository of individual banks' Pillar 3 / nyilvánosságra hozatal reports was found. MNB publishes the disclosure RULES (recommendation 7/2022, superseding 9/2021, plus explanatory tájékoztató), but the actual Pillar 3 PDFs sit on each bank's own website (e.g. UniCredit Bank Hungary, CIB Bank published theirs on their own domains).
negative_findings.result_summary: Rules are centralised at MNB; documents are decentralised per institution.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Pillar 3 collection cannot be solved from this cell — it must be done bank-by-bank in the issuer/IR cells, using the MNB register as the enumeration list and the MNB recommendation as the template schema.

negative_findings.description: Searching Hungarian terms for ICAAP ('tőkemegfelelés belső értékelési folyamata') surfaced only MNB methodological/guidance material and bank risk reports, not any per-institution ICAAP outcome dataset published by MNB.
negative_findings.result_summary: ICAAP results are supervisory-confidential; only aggregate capital adequacy appears in the published supervisory tables.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets a realistic ceiling: capital-adequacy comparisons must be built from Aranykönyv/credit-institution tables, not from ICAAP outputs.

negative_findings.description: www.mnb.hu/en/supervision/time-series issued a 307 redirect to statisztika.mnb.hu/statistical-topics/supervisory-statistics, showing that MNB has migrated statistical content between hosts.
negative_findings.result_summary: Legacy mnb.hu statistical URLs redirect to the newer statisztika.mnb.hu portal.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Stored URLs will rot; the pipeline must follow redirects and re-resolve dataset URLs from index pages rather than caching deep links.

coverage_gaps.description: The interactive Aranykönyv and the Intézménykereső are JavaScript applications; the underlying data endpoints, file naming and pagination were not inspected in this pass (only their landing pages were identified).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a headless-browser network-trace pass against both apps to capture the XHR/JSON endpoints and the XLSX download URL patterns before building collectors.

coverage_gaps.description: Release timing for the Aranykönyv, quarterly credit-institution tables and payment statistics was not confirmed; MNB publishes a statistical release calendar that was not located in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Locate and parse the MNB publikációs naptár / release calendar on statisztika.mnb.hu to schedule fetches instead of polling blindly.

coverage_gaps.description: It is unconfirmed whether the Aranykönyv datasets and the Intézménykereső register share a stable institution identifier (MNB registration number, or LEI/company registration number) that would let per-bank financials be joined to licence records.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Compare identifier columns across one Aranykönyv XLSX and one register export; if absent, plan a name-normalisation + LEI crosswalk layer.

coverage_gaps.description: MNB's terms of use / reuse conditions and robots.txt for mnb.hu, statisztika.mnb.hu and intezmenykereso.mnb.hu were not read in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch and record robots.txt and the site's felhasználási feltételek for each of the three hosts before automated collection begins; set polite crawl rates.

coverage_gaps.description: English mirrors exist for the Golden Books, supervisory statistics and pressroom, but registers, decisions search and most recommendations appear HU-only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Plan HU-language parsing and machine translation for the register and decisions streams; do not assume an English equivalent exists.

brief: The MNB is by far the densest single node in the Hungarian banking/payments source landscape for institution-level disclosure data, and it splits cleanly across three hosts: statisztika.mnb.hu carries the quantitative datasets (Aranykönyv/Golden Book with per-institution audited balance sheet and P&L series from 2003, quarterly credit-institution tables and their archive, and payment statistics), www.mnb.hu carries the rules and events (disclosure recommendation 7/2022 superseding 9/2021, reporting templates, licensing guidance, supervisory decisions search, supervisory news and press releases), and intezmenykereso.mnb.hu carries the authoritative register of every licensed bank, payment institution and e-money issuer — the master actor list that feeds every other cell in this run. The critical structural finding is that MNB centralises the disclosure REQUIREMENTS but not the disclosure DOCUMENTS: individual Pillar 3 / nyilvánosságra hozatal reports live on each bank's own site, so this cell supplies the enumeration list and the template schema while the issuer cells must collect the PDFs. Main open risks are technical rather than availability-related: both the interactive Aranykönyv and the register are JavaScript apps whose data endpoints and download URL patterns still need a network-trace pass, MNB has demonstrably migrated statistical URLs across hosts (a 307 redirect from the old /en/supervision/time-series path), and it is unconfirmed whether the financial datasets and the register share a joinable institution identifier.
